WITH style_list_cte AS (
    SELECT
        DEPARTMENTID,
        DATETIME,
        TO_NCHAR(
            RTRIM(
                XMLAGG(
                    XMLELEMENT(e, STYLE || ',').EXTRACT('//text()')
                    ORDER BY STYLE
                ).GetClobVal(),
                ','
            )
        ) AS STYLE_LIST
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            DEPARTMENTID,
            TRUNC(INSERTDATETIME) AS DATETIME,
            STYLE
        FROM may_errordetailtest
        WHERE SOLUONG > 0 AND STYLE IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY DEPARTMENTID, DATETIME
),

data_cte AS (
    SELECT
        d.ERRORCODE,
        d.DEPARTMENTID,
        TRUNC(d.INSERTDATETIME) AS DATETIME,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '07:30:01' AND '08:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '08:30:01' AND '09:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '09:30:01' AND '10:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME3,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '10:30:01' AND '11:35:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME4,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '12:30:01' AND '13:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME5,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '13:30:01' AND '14:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME6,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '14:30:01' AND '15:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME7,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '15:30:01' AND '16:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME8,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '16:30:01' AND '18:00:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME9,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(d.INSERTDATETIME, 'HH24:MI:ss') BETWEEN '18:00:01' AND '20:30:00' THEN d.SOLUONG ELSE 0 END) AS TIME10,
        SUM(d.SOLUONG) AS SUM_TOTAL,
        MAX(c.errorname_vn) AS errorname_vn
    FROM may_errordetailtest d
    LEFT JOIN may_errorconfig c ON d.ERRORCODE = c.errorco
    WHERE d.SOLUONG > 0
    GROUP BY d.ERRORCODE, d.DEPARTMENTID, TRUNC(d.INSERTDATETIME)
)
SELECT
    dt.ERRORCODE,
    dt.DEPARTMENTID,
    sl.STYLE_LIST,
    dt.DATETIME,
    dt.TIME1, dt.TIME2, dt.TIME3, dt.TIME4, dt.TIME5,
    dt.TIME6, dt.TIME7, dt.TIME8, dt.TIME9, dt.TIME10,
    dt.SUM_TOTAL,
    dt.errorname_vn
FROM data_cte dt
LEFT JOIN style_list_cte sl
    ON dt.DEPARTMENTID = sl.DEPARTMENTID
   AND dt.DATETIME = sl.DATETIME
